# Actions

Buttons that change records, ask for input or run your own code, per role.

- [Record actions](../reference/ui-config.md#actions-and-views-per-role): Buttons that update fields, delete, open a link, run an AI action or call your own code.
- [Actions that ask for input](../reference/ui-config.md#actions-that-ask-for-input): An action opens a dialog for text, numbers, dates, choices or records before it runs.
- [Conditional and bulk actions](../reference/ui-config.md#where-an-action-applies): Actions show, or show disabled with a reason, only where a condition holds, and run on several selected rows at once.
- [Views per role](../reference/ui-config.md#actions-and-views-per-role): Each role can get its own view of a resource, with other columns, filters, layout and actions.
- [Named actions](../reference/layouts.md#named-actions): An action is declared once in a view and used as a button on lists, record pages and composed pages.
